result.title: Accounting Policy Manual - posting authority, support, approvals
result.text:
HALVARD SYSTEMS - ACCOUNTING POLICY MANUAL (excerpt), effective 2026-01-01
Applies to Halvard Systems Inc. (US), Halvard Systems Ltd (UK), Halvard Systems GmbH (DE).

1. Posting authority. Senior accountants may post manual journal entries up to USD 10,000
   per entry (local-currency entries are measured at the month-end rate of the entry month).
   Any entry above USD 10,000 must be routed to the Controller with an approval request
   (request_approval) immediately after posting; it remains pending until approved.
   Splitting one transaction into several entries to stay under the threshold is prohibited.
2. Support. Every journal entry must have its supporting document(s) attached. An entry
   without support is not a valid entry.
3. Capitalization. Individual equipment purchases of USD 2,500 or more (local-currency
   equivalent at the month-end rate) are capitalized to 1500 Computer Equipment and
   depreciated over 36 months beginning the month after acquisition.
4. Prepaids. Payments covering services or events in future periods (more than one month
   out, or spanning more than one month) above USD 1,000 are recorded as prepaid (1210
   Prepaid Software for software, 1220 Prepaid Insurance for insurance, 1200 Prepaid Expenses
   for everything else, including deposits for future events) and expensed straight-line over
   the coverage period starting the month coverage begins, or when the event occurs.
5. Accruals. Expenses are recorded in the period the goods or services are received. Services
   received but not yet invoiced at month-end are accrued to 2100 Accrued Expenses using the
   best available evidence (vendor statements, approved timesheets, engagement terms).
   Quotes or proposals for future work are not liabilities.
6. Revenue. Revenue is recognized under ASC 606 per the contract terms. Deferred revenue
   (2200) is released as performance obligations are satisfied. Usage earned but not yet
   invoiced is recorded to 1300 Unbilled Receivables.
7. Customer credits. SLA credits are issued only per contract terms and verified uptime data
   (see the monthly uptime report). Credits are recorded as a reduction of the related revenue.
8. Cash application. Customer receipts are applied to invoices per remittance advice. Receipts
   that cannot be matched to an open invoice remain in 2950 Unapplied Cash.
9. FX. Monetary balances denominated in a currency other than the entity's functional
   currency are remeasured at the month-end rate; gains/losses go to 6950 FX Gain/Loss.
   Intercompany charges are recorded by the receiving entity at the month-end rate of the
   month charged.
10. Payroll. Returned payroll deposits are recorded to 2150 Accrued Payroll & Unclaimed
   Wages until reissued. Unpaid wages at month-end are accrued to 2150.
11. Exceptions. Items that cannot be supported must be reported via flag_exception. Never
   post an entry to force a reconciliation or to make balances agree.
12. Periods. January and February 2026 are closed. March 2026 is open.

args.description: JE-00298 (DE, 2026-03-29, memo "Umsatzkorrektur Q1") debits 1100 AR / credits 4000 Subscription Revenue for EUR 9,999.00 with NO supporting document, no customer or invoice reference, and no contract basis. Posted manually by m.krause at 23:47 on a Sunday. Under Policy s.2 an entry without support is not valid; under s.1 the entry equals ~USD 10,998.90 at the March month-end rate (1.10) and therefore exceeded the USD 10,000 posting authority with no approval request made. Amount just under the EUR-nominal threshold is a red flag. All three DE March subscription invoices (RE-7107/7108/7109, EUR 21,100) are already booked and collected, so there is no unbilled Q1 revenue evident. Recommend controller review and reversal unless substantiation is produced; not reversed by me because no document exists to support either direction.

args.text:
DE (Halvard Systems GmbH) - March 2026 cutoff and journal-entry review
Prepared by: senior accountant, 2026-04-03

SCOPE
Reviewed all 28 DE ledger entries in period 2026-03 against source documents, plus the April-dated document store, for (a) items booked in the wrong period and (b) entries lacking support or exceeding posting authority (Policy DOC-0005).

1. CUTOFF CORRECTION - POSTED
JE-00305 (2026-03-31, ap.clerk): Dr 5000 Hosting / Cr 2000 AP, EUR 5,600.00, Nordwolke Hosting NW-2026-0402.
Support DOC-0206 shows invoice date 2026-04-02 and service period 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-30 ("Dedicated cluster, April"). This is an April expense (Policy s.5 - expenses recorded in the period services are received). It was booked to March in error.
Action: reversed via JE-00306 dated 2026-03-31, support DOC-0206 attached. March 5000 Hosting activity is now EUR 8,735.13 (NOR-92853 only, March service period) and AP is reduced by EUR 5,600.
Follow-up: attempted to rebook the invoice in April dated 2026-04-02; the system rejected it because 2026-04 is not yet open. The EUR 5,600 Nordwolke bill must be re-entered to 5000/2000 when April opens (DOC-0206). No P&L or liability is lost - it is simply an April item.

2. UNSUPPORTED / OVER-AUTHORITY ENTRY - ESCALATED (EXC-001)
JE-00298 (2026-03-29 23:47, manual, m.krause): Dr 1100 AR / Cr 4000 Subscription Revenue, EUR 9,999.00, memo "Umsatzkorrektur Q1".
- No supporting document attached; no customer, invoice number or contract reference; nothing in the document store references it (searched "Umsatzkorrektur", "Krause", DE revenue/email).
- All three DE March subscription invoices (RE-7107 Kessler EUR 8,800; RE-7108 Brandt EUR 7,200; RE-7109 Vogel EUR 5,100 = EUR 21,100) are booked and cash-collected, so there is no evidence of unbilled or under-recognised Q1 subscription revenue.
- At the March policy rate (EUR 1.10) the entry is ~USD 10,998.90, above the USD 10,000 senior-accountant limit; no request_approval was made. The EUR amount sitting just under 10,000 is a red flag.
- Posted late Sunday night, two days before period end.
Effect if reversed: DE March 4000 Subscription Revenue would fall from EUR 31,099 to EUR 21,100 and AR by EUR 9,999.
I did NOT reverse it, because there is no document to support either the entry or its reversal, and Policy s.11 requires unsupported items to be flagged rather than posted against. Recommend the controller obtain substantiation from m.krause or direct a reversal before the period is locked.

3. OTHER ENTRIES - NO EXCEPTIONS
- AP bills (Spreeblick SPR-11495, Kiefer KIE-25621, Nordwolke NOR-92853, Vattenfall VAT-86380, Alster ALS-50525): all have March 2026 service periods per their invoices and are correctly in March; all paid in March.
- AR invoices RE-7107/7108/7109: March service period, supported, collected in March.
- Payroll 3/15 and 3/30 and funding transfers: supported, in period.
- Card transactions (Lufthansa x2, Deutsche Bahn, Staples, Dallmayr x2): small, supported, March-dated.
- No DE documents with a March service period were found unbooked (no missing accruals identified from the document store); no April-dated DE ledger entries exist.

4. CHECKLIST
DE "AP cutoff review" marked complete. Bank reconciliation, depreciation, prepaid amortisation, payroll accrual, intercompany and revenue recognition items were outside the scope of this request and remain open.

Entries posted: JE-00306 (reversal of JE-00305, EUR 5,600, DOC-0206).
Exceptions logged: EXC-001 (JE-00298, EUR 9,999).
Open follow-ups: rebook NW-2026-0402 in April; controller decision on JE-00298 before lock.
